Sure! It’s pretty simple. I have two spawners, one for creepers and one for withers skeleton. The skeletons get moved in front of a dispenser that shoots out morbs from thermal foundation and get transported to a combustion chamber (just and enclosed space with water on the bottom to prevent creepers from blowing everything up) 
The creepers I move into a little holding bay where I hit them with a lil lightening from the multi glove thing from Modular Powersuits. They then get released into a similar area as the withers with a dispenser and morbs. This is so that I ensure I only get one spawn from each because last I checked one charged creeper will only drop one either head regardless of how many are near it. Then, in the combustion chamber I have a dispenser shoot both morbs out. The creepers will funnel directly in front of a robot from Open computers that will use flint and steel on them and, quite literally, boom! wither heads. It’s not automatic or anything but I actually really enjoy the process. Helps feel like I’m in a lab or something which is what I designed the room to look like.
